implementation_strategy: Execute confirmatory paired runs (500 intents) against a single hosted LLM endpoint (gpt-5-mini) for generation; deterministic CPU-based verifiers run inside Docker containers to validate generated configuration changes; guarded condition invokes generate_validate_repair_v1 workflow invoking at most one additional LLM repair call per intent (adhering to adapter per-task max of 2 calls). All orchestration, logging, hashing, and scoring automated. No human scoring or manual adjudication.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic generation of 500 intents from intent_spec_v1 stratified evenly across 10 topology profiles (50 per profile) using a frozen sampling seed. 60% templateable / 40% complex split enforced. Task identifiers = integers 1..500.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline uses direct_configuration_generation_v1. Guarded uses generate_validate_repair_v1 with deterministic config_normalization and anonymization pre/post steps executed by CPU verifiers in Docker. No retrieval-augmented generation.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic fixed sampling seed (seed_id: study-hosted-netops-gvr-v1-seed-2026-08-29) used to generate the 500-intent corpus and the 100-intent exploratory subsample. No per-condition independent sampling (paired design).
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses keyed by (task_id, condition, prompt-hash). Verifier outputs and normalized configs cached. Cache avoids duplicate hosted calls but does not increase total planned call budget. All caches persisted in execution manifest with content hashes.
failure_recovery_plan: No LLM call retries per-call (adapter maximum_attempts_per_call=1). Technical infra failures or API errors cause the affected pair to be logged as technical failure and excluded from primary 'complete_pair_primary' analysis; such pairs retained for sensitivity analysis treating them as unsafe. Docker verifier restarts attempted once per batch; verifier runtime errors logged and treated as technical failures per missingness_plan.
result_schema: Per-episode record with fields: study_id, task_id, condition, intent_hash, model_calls_count, generated_config (anonymized), normalized_config, verifier_primary_pass (bool), verifier_secondary_pass (bool, for 5% audit), flags (parser_error, verifier_error, anonymization_placeholder), wall_time_ms, batch_id, seed_id, artifact_hashes. Deterministic automated scoring produces binary success = final accepted change passes primary deterministic verifier.
estimated_compute_notes: Total worst-case hosted model calls = 500 tasks * up to 2 calls/task = 1000 calls to openai_responses (gpt-5-mini). All verifier work runs on CPU hosts within Docker containers; expected wall-clock execution ≤ 7 days including ensemble re-verification and IO. Storage for raw artifacts ~ <10GB compressed. Model-call budget (1000) <= capability_manifest.maximum_planned_model_calls (10000) and equals adapter maximum_model_calls (1000).
